MISCELLANEOUS AMENDMENTS (NAME OF
GOVERNMENT MINISTRIES) ACT 2012
Act No. 5 of 2012
AN ACT TO AMEND THE NAME OF GOVERNMENT MINISTRIES IN
VARIOUS ACTS
I assent,
GEORGE TUPOU VI,
20th July 2012.
BE IT ENACTED by the King and the Legislative Assembly of Tonga in the Legislature
of the Kingdom as follows:
1 Short Title
This Act may be cited as the Miscellaneous Amendments (Name of Government
Ministries) Act 2012.
2 Schedule 1 - Acts amended
The various Acts listed in column 1 of the Schedule shall be amended as set out in
the relevant entry in column 2 of the Schedule.
Passed by the Legislative Assembly on this 25th day of June 2012.
